decisions.reason: Persistent hover help does not change or resolve the separate requirement for a visible cue identifying editable fields.
The label-content and hover rules do not necessarily change the underlying representation used for text entry.
The source does not change the calendar-dropdown method required for date selection.
The source describes help-label persistence after users replace field content, not whether a placeholder clears when the field is activated.
Matching a help label to the field's initial text does not alter the existing Danish-language or placeholder-text requirements.
Interactive-field hover labels are unrelated to layout and style stability during legacy-content transfer.
The source does not affect containment or layout stability of pasted tables and columns.
The help-label behavior does not change bullet sizing, balance, alignment, color, or visual reference.
The source contains no decision about the template theme-color palette.
Interactive-field help labels do not change Tab-based list hierarchy or nested-list alignment.
The source uses 'label' to describe interactive-field help content and does not modify heading, title, or caption typography.
